thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: High error rate observed on /v1/embeddings (prod). Alert threshold crossed 5m ago (5xx rate > 8%).
maya: Seeing customer reports and elevated 5xxs in the dashboard. Latency also increased to ~1.6s p50 -> 2.4s p50 across region-us.
jon: I can confirm. Trace sample shows a lot of object-fetch timeouts to our model-store GCS bucket. 504s coming back from storage layer.
alex: I pulled the logs for the failing request ids. Pattern: GET to gs://redwood-models/* returning 503 / read timeout.
katie: Is this the same issue we saw last year with the GCS backend throttling during heavy list/GET bursts?
maya: Possibly. I'm on vendor chat. Opening vendor ticket now.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-15-01. Severity: Sev2. Pager duty escalation: oncall-rotation.
oncall-rotation: Oncall here. Taking lead. Quick ask: do we have a recent warm cache snapshot to avoid cold loads?
jon: We do for most models for hosted plan. But embeddings path sometimes fetches larger keys that aren't cached. Suggest toggling model prefetch FF for embeddings-heavy routes to avoid on-demand GCS pulls.
maya: I'm drafting a status page update, will share before publishing. Also contacting Google Cloud (GCP) support for storage escalation.
cloud-eng-gcp: Assigned GCP case: 1234567890. Contacted Storage SRE, they acknowledge elevated 5xx in region-us-west1 and are investigating. Suggested mitigation: retry with exponential backoff + reduce parallel reads.
vendor-support-bw: BlobWorks Support (vendor-monitor-bot) joined. We see increased error rates between 09:02-09:06 UTC hitting object download subservice in us-west1. Case BW-8572 opened.
alex: Mitigation attempt 1: enabled aggressive retry/backoff in edge-proxy config for embeddings route (config hash d3f2). Rolling to 10% of traffic now.
jon: Rolling ok at 10%. Errors on that shard dropped from 10% -> 6% but overall still high.
katie: While we roll, we should prepare a customer communication for those on dedicated and private. Focus: what happened, impact, ETA.
maya: Draft status page copy: 

---
Status: Partial degradation
Affected Services: Embeddings & model artifact loads (hosted API)
Start time: 2026-03-15T09:00:56Z
Current status: engineering investigating; temporary retries applied; vendor engagement opened
Impact: A subset of requests to embeddings may fail or see elevated latency. Customers using pinned private deployments with local model cache shouldn't be affected.
Next update: in 30 minutes
---

Please review.
jon: Suggest adding remote mitigation step we did (retry/backoff roll + prefetch toggle). Also mention case IDs: GCP 1234567890, BW-8572.
maya: Added both.
incident-bot: Proposed status update ready. Who will publish?
alex: I can publish status page after maya approves wording. Will also attach minimal technical note for customers: how to optionally increase client-side retries and enable local caching.
katie: Draft customer email for impacted paid customers: 

Subject: Brief outage affecting embeddings (Mar 15)
Hi <Customer>,
We observed elevated error rates and latency for the Redwood embeddings endpoint starting at 09:00 UTC. Root cause: transient failures fetching model artifacts from a cloud storage backend (GCS).
What we're doing: engineering applied retry/backoff at the edge, toggled prefetch for embeddings, and engaged GCP + BlobWorks for deeper investigation.
Impact: Some requests may have returned 5xx or experienced higher latency. If you rely on embeddings for synchronous user flows, you may see errors or slow responses.
Workaround: increase client retries with exponential backoff to 3 attempts, or configure local model caching if using Dedicated/Private.
Next update: we'll follow up within 60 minutes and when the issue is resolved.
Regards,
Redwood Inference Operations

jon: Good. Add the case numbers and the oncall contact line for enterprise customers: +1-555-0112 (ops duty).
maya: On vendor call now. BlobWorks says they saw sporadic control-plane throttling tied to a reconfiguration event at 08:58 UTC. They claim storage plane is recovering but will keep the case open for 4 hours.
vendor-support-bw: BW-8572 update: reconfiguration rollback completed at 09:08 UTC; internal metrics show 95% recovery of GET success within 5m. Monitoring for regressions.
alex: Rolling retries to 50% and enabling prefetch for all embeddings traffic in region-us-west1. Watch window for 5 minutes.
jon: After ramp to 50% we see p50 latency down to 1.1s and 5xxs at 2.2% on that cohort. Good signal.
katie: Recommend sending the status page update now and the customer email to impacted buckets (hosted customers and dedicated customers on us-west1). I'll coordinate with growth for any external comms.
maya: Published status page update: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-03-15-01 (draft link).
incident-bot: status-page: update posted by alex at 1772004200.
cloud-eng-gcp: GCP update: Storage SRE is continuing post-incident validation. No ongoing throttling detected in our telemetry after 09:12 UTC but will keep the case open until 13:00 UTC for correlation checks.
vendor-support-bw: BW-8572: monitoring OK. Recommend closing if no regressions in next 3h.
maya: We're seeing normalized error rate but some customer-side retries still propagating errors. I'll prepare the 'incident resolved' template that includes timeline + mitigation steps.
oncall-rotation: Preparing handoff to evening oncall (alex covers next). Key items to pass: 
- GCP case 1234567890 + BW-8572
- Prefetch toggled for embeddings in us-west1 (config d3f2)
- Edge retry/backoff enabled, currently at 50% ramp
- Status page updated and customer emails queued
- Watchlist: any regressions in 10-30m and correlation with deployments (none planned until 13:30 UTC)

alex: Acknowledge, will monitor. If errors >3% again, I'll escalate with GCP lead and request expedited postmortem.
sre-lead: Good coordination. For the incident record, capture timeline + who we paged at 09:02. Also note vendor reconfiguration rollback as probable root cause. We'll schedule a follow-up postmortem with BlobWorks and GCP liaison.
katie: I'll own the customer communications thread and send targeted follow-ups to enterprise customers with the case IDs and recommended client-side mitigations.
maya: Final note before handoff: keep RW feature-flag 'embeddings-prefetch' enabled for 4 hours, then evaluate rollback after telemetry.
incident-bot: Handoff: thread assigned to alex at 1772005820.
alex: Thanks all. Monitoring live for next 3 hours. If anything new pops up ping me directly or call +1-555-0112. :thumbsup:
